insurance_business_line.label: Insurance business line
insurance_business_line.value: Specialty property and casualty insurance for commercial and residential customers, including catastrophe coverage.

risk_underwriting_distribution_model.label: Risk underwriting / distribution model
risk_underwriting_distribution_model.value: Primary specialty insurer with in-house underwriting, including excess and surplus casualty, and distribution through agents, brokers and partners.

premium_exposure_mix.label: Premium / exposure mix
premium_exposure_mix.value: Commercial and residential exposure across earthquake, casualty, inland marine and property, crop, and surety and credit.

combined_ratio_p_c_underwriting.label: Combined ratio [P&C underwriting]
combined_ratio_p_c_underwriting.value: Calendar-year combined ratio on net earned premiums. Adjusted combined ratio uses adjusted underwriting expenses, with a separate measure excluding catastrophe losses.

loss_lae_ratio_p_c_underwriting.label: Loss / LAE ratio [P&C underwriting]
loss_lae_ratio_p_c_underwriting.value: Calendar-year losses and loss adjustment expenses relative to net earned premiums. The attritional loss ratio excludes catastrophe losses.

reinsurance_catastrophe_protection.label: Reinsurance / catastrophe protection
reinsurance_catastrophe_protection.value: Excess-of-loss catastrophe reinsurance, including catastrophe bond protection, and quota-share cessions.

notes: The relative premium weights of the disclosed product categories are uncertain.
